{"idea":"Substitute the given formulas for f and g at x and y. Each equality then says the square of the variable solves z² = 5z − 6, so the two squared values are 2 and 3; the strict inequality fixes their order.","proof":"have hx : x ^ 2 = 2 ∨ x ^ 2 = 3 := by
  rw [h₀ x, h₁ x] at h₂
  have hxpoly : (x ^ 2 - 2) * (x ^ 2 - 3) = 0 := by nlinarith
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hxpoly with h | h
  · left
    nlinarith
  · right
    nlinarith
have hy : y ^ 2 = 2 ∨ y ^ 2 = 3 := by
  rw [h₀ y, h₁ y] at h₃
  have hypoly : (y ^ 2 - 2) * (y ^ 2 - 3) = 0 := by nlinarith
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hypoly with h | h
  · left
    nlinarith
  · right
    nlinarith
rcases hx with hx | hx <;> rcases hy with hy | hy <;> nlinarith","insight_statement":"","insight_proof":""}
